definitions: The past simple form of 'I take', indicating that I performed the action of taking something at a specific point in the past.
To have carried out the action of grasping, acquiring, or accepting something in the past.
To have consumed or ingested something in the past.
To have made a photograph or recording in the past.
examples: I took the book from the shelf.
I took the bus to work.
I took a photo of the sunset.
I took a break after an hour.
pastTenses: I took, I have taken, I had taken
